candidate_policy: among finite ASCD post-processor top-k tokens, mask only a canonical CHAIR-object candidate with cached OWLv2 score < threshold
fallback_policy: never use Vanilla logits or token; if masking would leave no finite token, retain the original ASCD distribution
non_object_policy: leave all non-object ASCD scores unchanged
runtime_score: max sigmoid OWLv2 detection logit over predicted boxes for each query
